name: Ops fix
description: Fix something broken on the VPS or in CI the tools at hand can fix (a dead key, a stuck or crashed build, a failed launch, CI red, a restarting container, missing config), the shared rule 'Fix it yourself'.
author: AmberX AXF

data.brief:
Fix this: {{problem}} (systems check item: {{check}}).
1. Confirm it is still broken and find the cause; read logs, do not guess.
2. Fix it with the tools at hand. A code change goes on a branch with a PR, never straight to main.
3. If it needs Brett's hands (a new token on github.com, paying, a device), stop and say exactly what he must do.
4. Re-run the check that showed it red.
Report the cause, the fix, before/after of the check, and anything left for Brett.
